_readme: Per-run judgment prose for the dashboard. The ONLY narrative input scripts/smith_dashboard.py accepts -- everything else it derives from state files. Both keys optional; omit one and its panel is skipped. Keep each to a short paragraph: the chat briefing carries the full narrative, this is the collapsed reference copy.
session_read: Friday 2026-07-24 closed as a severe, broad AI-capex/semis selloff -- weighted avg -5.06% across the 21 names then held, worst SNDK -10.79%, COHR -9.84%, CLS -8.80%, DRAM -8.75%. Coinciding with that session the book de-risked hard: GLW/NBIS/IREN fully exited and eight names roughly halved, taking wallet cash from $5,656.86 to $18,131.51 (45.8% of book). Read as one de-risking event, not two -- the exact trigger (stop-loss rule vs discretionary vs planned earnings-week de-risk) was never captured (G26). Markets closed over the weekend; next real decision point is Monday's reopen.
macro: Fed funds 3.63%, stance HAWKISH, next check 2026-07-29. Four earnings prints land on held names this week: GLW and TER on 07-28, QCOM and LRCX on 07-29 -- binary events against a book already at maximum single-factor concentration, which argues against sizing up into them.
